successors.text: Taleh and the interior of British Somaliland

successors.name: Italian Africa
successors.text: the Nugaal Valley, "from Halin to Eyl"

rulers.name: Mohammed Abdullah Hassan
rulers.title: Sayyid, leader of the Salihiyya Dervishes

ledger.x: 1899: the Dervish movement of Mohammed Abdullah Hassan begins at Taleh.
1903: the Dervishes hold the Nugaal Valley from Halin to Eyl.
5 March 1905: the Treaty of Illig cedes the Nugaal Valley.
1908: the Dervishes again enter British Somaliland.
March-April 1910: the British evacuate the interior and the Dervishes hold it.

9 August 1913: Dul Madoba, the last clash with "the only remaining British mobile force in the colony"; the British had evacuated the interior in March-April 1910 and the Dervish state page has the walled town at Taleh built "in 1913, after the British withdrawal to the coast".
February 1920: the Dervish state ends at Taleh.

wars.name: Somaliland campaign
wars.outcome: British victory in 1920: the Taleh forts fell and the Dervish movement ended with the Mullah's death; in between the Nugaal Valley was ceded to the Dervishes under Italian protection (Illig, 5 March 1905) and the British withdrew to the coast.

certainty.note: Nomadic, no frontier lines; only the Nugaal Valley is a named cession (1905).
